items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: Yeah, I've heard of Kato. Yeah, the old man.

ctx.x: And the main sound was the drum. Because they had to have Kato.

You were talking about Kato. Yeah, I've heard of Kato. Yeah, the old man. Mm-hmm. Well, Kato had got old and couldn't keep up in the back. Mm-hmm. So, you know, the old man. Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Well practically that band, the two main bands, was the band taught me all the humor to just play now. Well I played with them years ago with Amos Rock. And I played with that band, that brass band, and after I quit that band, I joined the top seat of the brass band.
And that's where I stayed, in the brass band. Tell me a little more about the Tulane brass band. Amos Raleigh was the leader and manager Bo?
